- The **Samantapāsādikā** on the Vinaya Piṭaka (which directly answers your question)

- The **Papañcasūdanī** on the Majjhima Nikāya
- The **Sāratthappakāsinī** on the Saṃyutta Nikāya
- The **Manorathapūraṇī** on the Aṅguttara Nikāya
- Various commentaries on the Abhidhamma Piṭaka

His translation work standardized Theravāda exegesis and elevated Pāli as the scholarly lingua franca of the tradition, ensuring these commentaries could be disseminated and studied across the Theravāda world.

Introduced by Vladimir Lenin in 1921, the NEP replaced the policy of War Communism. A key component of the NEP was the **prodnalog** (продналог) — literally "food tax" — which replaced the previous forced grain requisitioning. The prodnalog was officially introduced by the decree "On the Tax in Kind" (О натуральном налоге) on March 21, 1921, marking the first major act of the New Economic Policy.
